headline: The one leg you never rehearsed is the one the morning handed you - 7 km/h gusts on Santos at the gun.
body:
Every open-water window this block read **'no'** on 63-100 km/h gusts, which is why the sea swim never happened. Santos at the gun: **7 km/h**, flat, no rain. You swam the calmest water of the month.

You are ten minutes into the bike as this lands. Km 0-20: **135-145 bpm, 28-30 km/h**, full sentences or you are over. Km 20-70: **140-150 bpm**, five to eight words. Gusts stay under **16 km/h** to 10:00, then build to **25 SE** through the run. Spin from km 70.

First 5 km off the bike: **6:45-7:00/km at 145-155**. On 13 September you ran **6:10/km on 152 bpm** seven minutes off a 67 km ride, with **24 m/km** of climbing under it. Faster than today's band. Run 9, walk 1, from km 1.

**80 g/hr** on the bike. It tops out at **19 C**, so sodium at the low end.

The watch has not reached Garmin since 13 September. If it is not recording, ride the talk test - that was always the real control.
